branchName.instructions: Prefix branches with feat/, fix/ or chore/.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits. Mark breaking changes with ! as well.

pullRequest.instructions: Use a Conventional Commit as the title: it becomes the squash commit and the changelog entry. Lead with a one-paragraph summary and include a Test plan section. If the PR contains more than one user-facing change, end the description with a BEGIN_COMMIT_OVERRIDE ... END_COMMIT_OVERRIDE block listing each feat and fix as its own Conventional Commit line.
